name: Air Fryer Beef Cheeseburgers with Potato Wedges

components.name: Cheeseburger Patties
steps: Divide beef into four 200 g raw portions, shape into flat patties with shallow centre indentations; season both sides with the listed salt and black pepper.
Air fry burgers at 200 C in batches, turning once. Check that the centres reach at least 71 C for ground beef. Top each patty with one cheese slice for the final minute.
Pack burgers, buns, wedges and cold toppings separately for four meals. Freeze cooked patties and wedges if necessary; add buns and salads fresh.

components.name: Potato Wedges
steps: Wash and cut potatoes into even wedges; dry and toss with measured oil, smoked paprika and salt.
Air fry potato wedges at 195 C for 18-24 minutes, shaking halfway through, until browned and cooked inside. Hold warm.

components.name: Bun & Toppings

ingredients.name: Four burger buns at 70 g each

steps: Lightly toast buns separately. Wash and dry lettuce; slice tomatoes and gherkins. Spread measured ketchup and mustard on buns when serving.
